name: Pact of the Tome
description:
Conjure your Book of Shadows at the end of a Short or Long Rest. Only you access its Pact magic. It disappears when replaced or you die. While carrying it, gain three additional cantrips from any class spell list and two level-1 Ritual spells you do not otherwise know. They count as Warlock spells and the book is a focus. When a replacement book appears, choose its starter spells again; this does not replace ordinary known spells or recharge its limited uses.

This test resolves the ritual boundary conservatively: starter Ritual spells are available as rituals, not as extra normal Pact-slot spells unless independently known. A ritual adds ten minutes to normal casting time and spends no slot; it still requires components and concentration where applicable. This procedural restriction is proposed, because the 5.5e version can support broader slot casting. Book of Ancient Secrets separately buys discovered higher ritual inscription; it does not give a second starter pair.
deepenedAtLevel5: At Warlock 5, gain one separate slot-free level-3 casting each of Animate Dead, Haste, and Call Lightning per Long Rest. Retain components, casting times, durations, concentration, and creature commands. These are three independent uses, not a shared pool. This test does not add them to normal Pact-slot casting unless separately learned. Replacing the book never recharges these uses.
